# coaffiliate(), ported inline: incidence matrix, then B x t(B)
kept = memberships

people = unique(memberships$member_id)   # everyone stays a node
nodes = tibble(name = c(people, unique(kept$committee_id)))
g = graph_from_data_frame(kept %>% select(member_id, committee_id),
                          directed = FALSE, vertices = nodes)
V(g)$type = V(g)$name %in% kept$committee_id
B = as_biadjacency_matrix(g, names = TRUE, sparse = FALSE)  # people x committees
P = B                                   # project onto people

K = P %*% t(P)                           # shared affiliations
A = K                                   # weight = count shared
diag(A) = 0
A[K < 1] = 0
gp = graph_from_adjacency_matrix(A, mode = "undirected", weighted = TRUE)

tibble(nodes = vcount(gp), edges = ecount(gp),
       density = edge_density(gp),
       clustering = transitivity(gp, type = "global"),
       total_weight = sum(E(gp)$weight))
code.sql:
-- self-join the membership table on the shared committee
WITH kept AS (
  SELECT * FROM memberships
),
sizes AS (
  SELECT committee_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM kept GROUP BY committee_id
)
SELECT a.member_id AS node_1, b.member_id AS node_2,
       COUNT(*) AS shared,
       SUM(1.0 / MAX(s.n - 1, 1)) AS newman
FROM kept a
JOIN kept b ON a.committee_id = b.committee_id AND a.member_id < b.member_id
JOIN sizes s ON s.committee_id = a.committee_id
GROUP BY a.member_id, b.member_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1;
